Auto Fix: pick the problem the game has
Let Turnip draw the whole frame in memory (sysmem)
Turn off Turnip\'s LRZ (fixes black spots, flickering)
Turn off Turnip\'s UBWC compression (fixes black patches, stripes, wrong colors)
Turn off DXVK async (no more flickering, may stutter more at first)
Unpack all BCn textures (fixes black or missing textures)
Let the Unity game pick its own picture quality
Switch sound output to %1$s
Run the game in Japanese (fixes broken text in Japanese games)
Run the game in Chinese (fixes broken text in Chinese games)
Lite Run: run the Godot game directly on Android, without Wine (much smoother)
Read movies Wine\'s old way (for movies Wine can\'t open, like MP4 with MP3 audio)
Lite Run: run the game\'s page (Electron, NW.js) directly on Android, without Wine (much smoother)
Lite Run: run the RPG Maker game directly on Android, without Wine (much smoother)
Let the Godot game (Lite Run) draw with OpenGL
Let the Godot game (Lite Run) draw with Vulkan
Run the game without mods (%1$s), like the original; the game\'s files stay as they are
Use Wine\'s %1$s instead of the game\'s own (cheats or mods in this file won\'t work; the game\'s files stay as they are)
Send touches as a real mouse (for games that only read a real mouse, like Unity games using Input System)
Send touches as before (like other games)
Run the game\'s 64-bit version (%1$s) instead of the 32-bit one
Run the main game file (%1$s) instead of the launcher (.NET)
